service_inventory.retention: No repository-defined period; confirm the production account and provider settings before launch.

service_inventory.name: Google Fonts
service_inventory.purpose: Delivery of the Inter and Merriweather font files used by the public interface
service_inventory.retention: Controlled by the provider under its terms; Lawscope does not receive a font-request profile.

service_inventory.purpose: Delivery of the Font Awesome 6 icon stylesheet
service_inventory.retention: Controlled by the provider under its terms; Lawscope does not receive a CDN-request profile.

service_inventory.name: Not selected
service_inventory.purpose: Forwarding Contact form messages to a monitored Lawscope support destination
service_inventory.retention: No downstream period can be stated until the monitored delivery provider is selected.

service_inventory.name: Google Analytics 4
service_inventory.purpose: Consent-based audience measurement using a deliberately limited event set
service_inventory.retention: The production GA4 property must be confirmed at the two-month event-data retention setting before activation; aggregated reports may persist until deleted under the account policy.

service_inventory.name: Google AdSense
service_inventory.purpose: Consent-based responsive advertising, delivery measurement, frequency controls, and invalid-traffic protection after separate approval
service_inventory.retention: No AdSense request is made while inactive. Before activation, the owner must confirm Google’s current account controls, partner disclosures, consent configuration, retention practices, and applicable opt-out routes.

service_inventory.name: Not selected
service_inventory.retention: No subscriber email is collected while the feature remains inactive.
